cases.requirement: Nothing a chat turn reaches imports the training or fitting code.
A cohort is frozen by membership hash, not by a predicate re-evaluated later.
'These customers' distinguishes the rows that matched from every row belonging to those owners.
A widened cohort is a different cohort and says so.
A cohort re-resolved after the book moved is refused.
An empty cohort is refused, never answered with zero.
Two rules on one field over overlapping rows is a question, not a resolution.
An acknowledged overlap can be previewed with the resolution the reader chose.
A preview states what changes, over which rows, from what baseline, by which method, and what is left alone.
Reading a sensitivity is not approval of a calculation.
A confirmation is bound to a hash of everything that could change the answer.
A source refresh invalidates a confirmation.
A cohort edit invalidates a confirmation.
A method change invalidates a confirmation.
A warning the reader did not see invalidates a confirmation.
A revised scenario is a new version and is not confirmed.
Rule order is part of the digest, because order changes the answer.
A confirmed scenario survives into the next turn without being retyped, and is server-written.
A release change invalidates the confirmation AND drops the cohort binding, visibly.
One confirmed scenario, one reporting period, one frozen cohort, one baseline.
The full cohort is used, never the displayed rows and never the top contributors.
An unaffected row's change is exactly zero.
An ineligible row keeps its baseline and is reason-coded.
Full book equals affected plus unaffected.
Every method starts from the same baseline, read once.
Methods are shown side by side and never composed.
Different method coverage is disclosed and compared like-for-like.
An unavailable method shows reason and status, never a zero and never a substitution.
An unconfirmed or wrong-book scenario does not execute.
Missing user assumptions are resolved before execution.
The book is read and never written; execution is a simulation.
Fourteen domain failure categories exist, each mapped onto a code the runtime already has.

cases.note: states.ERROR_CODES is a protected constant; growing it would be a protected-core change made to avoid writing a mapping.
cases.requirement: No domain code was added to the protected core's error tuple.
Every category says what to do next.
An ambiguous unit and a rule conflict are QUESTIONS, not rejections.
A question carries its readings as choices the reader can pick.
A rejection travels as the existing contract, with the domain name preserved.
Cross-book access is a scope violation, not a data gap.
An unknown category cannot be raised.
An unqualified quantity is refused with the readings named, never resolved by a house default.
A field the book does not carry is refused by name, with what the book has.
A field a scenario may not move is refused rather than answered with zero.
An unseen category is refused with the book's real values, never matched by approximation.
A value outside a published support range is refused, not extrapolated silently.
A parameter driven outside its valid range is surfaced with the unclipped value, not clamped silently.
A missing model is MODEL_NOT_READY with a reason, never a zero.
A model trained against another release is refused.
A stale confirmation is refused with both hashes shown.
A reconciliation failure is a defect in the run, surfaced rather than absorbed.
Both books are off by default and each has its own flag.

Several factors aggregate as the declared linear sum, labelled as marginal.
The nonlinear translation at zero shock returns the observed baseline.
A factor that is not supportably estimable is refused for automatic translation; an explicit assumption is accepted.
An absent factor is UNAVAILABLE, never a sensitivity of zero.
A notch move steps the published scale.
Behavioural and application scorecards are kept separate.

The split is chronological by distinct period and leaks nothing.
The embargo is derived from label availability, reported, and no fold touches a test period.
